c10t_execution.diagnostic_step_failure: missing rims_c10t.paramnames; chain header itself contains the complete column map

c11g_predeclared_next_step.burnin_definition: fraction of integer-weight reconstructed Markov steps, not fraction of distinct accepted rows
c11g_predeclared_next_step.proposal_scale_matching_rule: determinant-match the c10t scale 3.4 to the new covariance, then test rounded 0.85x, 1.00x, 1.15x scales in a disposable sentinel
c11g_predeclared_next_step.sentinel_selection_rule: choose the lowest tested scale with aggregate acceptance in [0.20,0.50], all four chains in [0.10,0.70], and at least 10 distinct accepted rows per chain; otherwise stop
c11g_predeclared_next_step.shrinkage_selection_rule: choose the smallest candidate with correlation minimum eigenvalue >=0.10 and correlation condition number <=25

geometry_mismatch_diagnostic.interpretation: The remaining bottleneck is proposal orientation/conditional-width mismatch, not acceptance alone.
geometry_mismatch_diagnostic.source: within-chain c10t post-burn reconstructed states only; chain means removed before covariance pooling

independent_rank_reaudit.interpretation: Acceptance is healthy but cross-chain mixing and stationarity remain poor; proposal-scale tuning alone did not solve transport.
independent_rank_reaudit.method: integer-weight step reconstruction; 30 percent burn-in by reconstructed Markov steps; equalized post-burn tails; rank-normalized Rhat/bulk/tail ESS; per-chain half-chain drift
